title: Australian-Style Grilled Chicken
description: A spicy twist on traditional grilled chicken, inspired by Australian flavors. This dish is perfect for a summer evening.

ingredients.name: grill seasoning
ingredients.notes: such as salt, pepper, and paprika

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat (around 400°F/200°C).
In a small bowl, mix together the grill seasoning, rosemary, and a pinch of salt.
Brush the chicken breast with olive oil and sprinkle the seasoning mixture evenly over both sides.
Place the chicken on the grill and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
While the chicken is cooking, brush the grill with a bit more olive oil to prevent sticking.
Once the chicken is cooked, let it rest for a few minutes before slicing.
Serve the chicken with a drizzle of Australian barbecue sauce and a squeeze of lemon juice.
